description: This Swift source file defines an enumeration SoundEffectCatalog that manages system sound options including discovery, display, and retrieval via URLs. It also defines a SoundEffectPlayer enum responsible for loading and playing NSSound objects, either by name or from bookmarks. The file includes internal data structures for sound caching and search directories.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of system sound names, with "Glass" pinned first.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns the display name for a raw sound name (currently a passthrough).

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Fetches a URL for a given sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Retrieves an NSSound object by name, either by system name or from URL.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound from bookmark data with security scope handling.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the provided NSSound, stopping any previous sound.
